memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Chronic urticaria.
Evidence: daily pruritic wheals persisting >6 weeks, no identifiable trigger, no angioedema.
Symptoms and examination: patient reports intense itching on arms, trunk and back, wheals appearing and resolving within hours; afebrile, no mucosal swelling. Smoking status: never smoker, pack-years 0.

memories.author: D05
memories.text:
levocetirizine 5 mg oral tablet once daily
cetirizine 10 mg oral tablet at bedtime as needed for breakthrough itch

memories.author: lab
memories.text:
CBC: WBC 6.2 x10^9/L (4-10), Neutrophils 4.1, Lymphocytes 1.5, Monocytes 0.4, Eosinophils 0.2 x10^9/L (0.02-0.5), Hb 13.2 g/dL (12-16), Platelets 210 x10^9/L (150-400).
Thyroid function: TSH 2.1 mIU/L (0.4-4.0), Free T4 1.2 ng/dL (0.8-1.8).

Chronic urticaria.
Evidence: reduced frequency of hives, occasional breakthrough lesions mainly in evenings.
Symptoms and examination: patient notes milder itching, wheals now 2-3 times weekly, resolves with antihistamine; no angioedema. Smoking status: never smoker, pack-years 0.
